title: Owned OPC packages defer part payload decoding until fallible access
decision: retained, implemented; ADR 0030 is accepted and its C2' seam is complete
authority: Change 0652 decision 3 accepts ADR 0030 (lazy OPC part decode), and change 0651 queue row 3 dispatches the accepted C2' implementation. Change 0610 supplies the frozen design, migration surface, and gates.
reason_codes: Owned-source ingress retains one archive and defers typed-part payload inflation until a fallible accessor requests it.
The public Part::blob and Part::blob_arc signatures remain unchanged while get_part, get_part_mut, main_document_part, part_by_reltype, and try_iter_parts force and propagate typed failures.
Infallible iter_parts now exposes metadata without a payload route, preventing accidental hidden I/O or swallowed decode errors.
Deferred failures are recorded once and remain stable; failed members cannot become valid-looking empty payloads.
Exact source no-op publication intentionally copies the source archive without validating every untouched payload, while changed/materialized members are forced before publication.
Optional-part probes distinguish PartNotFound from decode, I/O, allocation, cancellation, and limit errors across the migrated format consumers.

accepted_evidence.focused_contract_tests: lazy_part_decode.rs has three passing tests: cold metadata and exact no-op, selected-part-only decode, and stable corrupt-member refusal.
accepted_evidence.opc_suite: cargo test -p litchi-opc -j2 passed 437 unit tests, all integration tests, and 5 doctests.
accepted_evidence.workspace_check: cargo check --workspace -j2 passed after the consumer error audit.
accepted_evidence.differential: differ-eager-vs-lazy.txt has 1,342 MATCH rows and zero MISMATCH rows across 336 fixtures.
accepted_evidence.cross_checkout: before/after cross-checkout artifacts compare equal for member observations, exact no-op, one-part reblob, and XLSX hide; cmp exits 0 for all four pairs.
accepted_evidence.read_sets: The 336-row corpus has 5,077 admitted parts and 45,562,463 inflated bytes across 334 successful opens. Exact no-op decodes 0 parts/0 bytes; one-part reblob decodes 334 parts/389,581 bytes; the current XLSX hide route publishes 33 fixtures and decodes 216/550 parts and 6,044,263/8,274,037 bytes among those published fixtures.

accepted_costs.metadata: Owned packages retain one deferred member handle and the source archive; a package that reads every member pays the bookkeeping and still performs the same payload work.
accepted_costs.error_timing: Actual inflated PartBytes and TotalPartBytes checks for deferred members occur at first access; declared-size central-directory preflight remains at open.
accepted_costs.api_break: iter_parts changes from payload-bearing parts to PartMetadata, and byte-bearing iteration uses the fallible try_iter_parts API, as authorized for early 0.0.x crates.
accepted_costs.measurement_scope: No timing, RSS, allocator, or release-mode performance claim is made; counters report work-set reads only.

known_gaps.xlsx_route_shape: The current semantic XLSX hide path decodes 216 of 550 published-fixture parts, so 0610's earlier one-part estimate is retained as design context and not claimed as an implementation result.
known_gaps.refused_operations: Signed, malformed, non-XLSX, noncompact, and skipped fixtures retain refusal outcomes; the read-set packet reports them rather than treating them as successful edits.
known_gaps.corrupt_exact_noop: Exact no-op output may preserve a known-corrupt untouched source member byte-for-byte. This is intentional source preservation; first access to the member still returns the recorded ZIP failure.
known_gaps.broad_measurement: Release-mode timing, peak RSS, and allocator measurement remain unrun and require a separate authorized measurement window.

withheld: any claim that the XLSX hide route reads exactly one part
any claim that an exact no-op validates or repairs a corrupt source member
any broad release-mode timing, RSS, or allocation result

provenance.commit: implementation commit; coordinator reports the final cherry-pick hash
provenance.note: The retained evidence and before-leg files are under results/change-0661. Shared before-* baseline artifacts remain until coordinator integration is complete.
